name: Oath
description: Oath: New Foundations for 2–7 players. Up to eight rounds, opened by the Chancellor or the first player.

limitOutcome.title: War Exhaustion
limitOutcome.body: The game ends after round eight. In order: an Imperial Oathkeeper means the Chancellor wins; else an Exile Usurper wins; else an Exile meeting a revealed Vision wins; else the Chancellor wins.

checks.title: End of round 5
checks.body: Is the Chancellor or a Citizen the Oathkeeper? If so, roll the end die. The Chancellor wins on a 6.

outcome.title: Stable Regime
outcome.body: A Citizen who meets the Successor goal wins instead.

checks.title: End of round 6
checks.body: Is the Chancellor or a Citizen the Oathkeeper? If so, roll the end die. The Chancellor wins on a 5 or 6.

outcome.title: Stable Regime
outcome.body: A Citizen who meets the Successor goal wins instead.

checks.title: End of round 7
checks.body: Is the Chancellor or a Citizen the Oathkeeper? If so, roll the end die. The Chancellor wins on 3 to 6.

outcome.title: Stable Regime
outcome.body: A Citizen who meets the Successor goal wins instead.

afterGame: Resolve the Chronicle task cards in order
Record lineage points on the era scorepad

setupSteps.label: Chancellor
setupSteps.description: The last game's winner plays the Chancellor in purple and opens every round. With no Chancellor, there is no Empire.

setupSteps.label: Citizens
setupSteps.description: Which players start as Citizens? Everyone else starts as an Exile.

setupSteps.label: First player
setupSteps.description: With no Empire, a random player takes the first player marker and opens every round.
